title: GOG Full Throttle Remastered $3.75
body:
Deal: GOG Full Throttle Remastered $3.75

[joshk] Full Throttle, The Dig, Day of the Tentacle, Sam and Max Hit the Road, Monkey Island. The Lucas games golden era
[HojuGuy] God-tier game. I grew up on point and click games.
Many thanks for the post!
[cbee] thanks OP
code GAMMAFOREVER add 10% off for me. score!
